name: @unframework.dev/toolchain-solid2
description: The solid2 test toolchain: Solid 2's runtime and compilers, which every solid2 layer resolves from here (ADR-0102), the checker and tsconfig that type-check every case's solid2 golden output in one run (L4), and the oxlint config, with eslint-plugin-solid as a JS plugin, that lints it (L5).
